definitions.explanation: The activity of pursuing and capturing wild animals.
Used as a suffix for gathering activities.

examples.japanese: {紅葉|もみじ}{狩|が}りを{楽|たの}しむ。
examples.notes: [Note: 狩り becomes がり as suffix]

examples.japanese: {鹿|しか}{狩|が}りの{季節|きせつ}
{父|ちち}は{若|わか}いころ、よく{狩|か}りに{出|で}かけていた。
examples.english: My father used to often go hunting when he was young.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると、{家族|かぞく}でいちご{狩|が}りやぶどう{狩|が}りに{行|い}くのが{恒例|こうれい}だ。
examples.english: When autumn comes, it's our family tradition to go strawberry picking or grape picking.

notes:
{狩|か}り means hunting or gathering.

AS HUNTING:
- {狩|か}りをする (to hunt)
- {猪|いのしし}{狩|が}り (boar hunting)
- {鹿|しか}{狩|が}り (deer hunting)
- {狐|きつね}{狩|が}り (fox hunting)

AS GATHERING (suffix がり):
- {紅葉|もみじ}{狩|が}り (autumn leaf viewing)
- {潮干|しおひ}{狩|が}り (shellfish gathering)
- きのこ{狩|が}り (mushroom hunting)
- いちご{狩|が}り (strawberry picking)
- ぶどう{狩|が}り (grape picking)

RELATED WORDS:
- {狩人|かりうど}/{狩人|かりゅうど} (hunter)
- {狩猟|しゅりょう} (hunting - formal)
